scope: Reference JSON schema and SQLite transaction contract via Python sqlite3; not the production Go adapter or domain restore validator
checks: generated JSON schema/example and fixture bundle hashes
missing/unknown fields, null arrays, month bounds, wide-number syntax, future version
SQLite v1 bootstrap, configured durability, atomic rollback at state/receipt boundaries, CAS and actor/key deduplication
close/reopen preserves receipts; durable rejection does not change game payload
locked-month failure retains lock/checkpoint; resolved world, deadline and completion receipt commit together and retry once
SQLite backup preserves consistent world/receipts/identity rows; integrity and foreign-key checks
